message: I've arrived with your {target} cup. Is this a good position for the handover? Select Ready if it is, or Cancel if you need me to stop.
rationale: When the robot reaches the handover point, it waits for the person to select Ready. I wanted to improve this by letting the person check the robot's position first. The robot might not always stop in a convenient spot, so this gives the person more control over whether the handover continues.
